build_volume_mm.rationale: Placeholder volume for a user-supplied generic FDM machine; replace before use.

dimensional_safety_margin_mm.rationale: Project starting margin for plate, fixture, and machine clearance; not a machine specification.

nozzle_diameter_mm.rationale: Common example nozzle used to make slicer assumptions explicit; replace with the installed nozzle.

nominal_layer_height_mm.rationale: Example layer height; layer height is a user/process setting.

wall_thickness_warning_mm.rationale: Conservative project starting point for a 0.4 mm nozzle; calibrate against the selected slicer and material.

wall_thickness_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary below the warning value; not a universal FDM limit.

minimum_feature_warning_mm.rationale: Project feature proxy starting point; feature height, orientation, and material are not modeled.

minimum_feature_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary near one example extrusion width; calibrate before production use.

overhang_warning_angle_deg.rationale: Warning angle from the horizontal plane under the documented downward-face convention.

overhang_critical_angle_deg.rationale: More severe downward slope under the documented convention; supports and bridges are not simulated.

build_plate_contact_tolerance_mm.rationale: Numerical contact tolerance for a mesh in millimetres; adapt to mesh accuracy and scale.

bridge_guidance.description: Bridge outcome depends on slicer bridge flow, cooling, span, layer height, and material; review in the selected slicer.

support_assumption.description: Support plan is not supplied; overhang and floating-component risks require user review.

notes: Project-default example only. Replace volume, nozzle, layer, thresholds, and material metadata before analysis.
